title: Every Backroad

lines.plain: Here she comes, she knows where I'll park when I'm David Hart
Cloud of dust, we keep dropping till we don't see no cars
I'm on the other side of town tonight, but she can always find me when I'm lost
She speaks for all the groove, she's like the needle on the record of my song
She knows every back road to my heart
I try to run, leave it all behind like I always did
She won't let go, she won't give in, it's a fight I'll never win
She knows every ball that the curve I feel when I'm lost and gone
And she brings me home She can read the road, got all my moods down
We ride those roads together It ain't been bad so far
She knows every back road to my heart
Jane, hide from her, she's in control No matter now, bees over in roads
That big ol' truck it never calls it quits
Sometimes he's drive too fast, too slow, too steady
For this broken soul she finds me in
Whatever state I'm in
Like a biker, once you find like hell
Like an old round dog, she's on my trail
This here train is off his track too far
Gone is no way back, a maybe way up in the hills
To find a shortcut, yes she will
When I find I'm at my worst
I pray to God that she got there first
She knows every back road to my heart
Here she comes
She knows where I park when the day's been hard
She knows when I'm wrong, she never says I'm right
But she knows when I'm broke, and she carries my spare parts
On a path to a first star, then I got lost so far
